services.name: Fishing Art
services.desc: Shark fishing in Cocoa Beach, Florida is unlike anything else on the planet, which is why so many people come back season after season. Unlike traditional deep sea fishing where you go out to the deep water. Shark fishing takes place closer in, inside the shoal. Shark fishing is good year round and good any time of day. We offer shark trips 3 times daily 7am to 11am, 12pm to 4pm & 5pm to 9pm nightly. Shark fishing trips are private charters, which means that it will be only your group with the captain. Since we are a private charter boat and we are able to fish in shallower water than larger boats, we are able to catch bigger sharks. Yes, the bigger sharks are in about 6 to 10 foot of water
